theme_and_concept.description: Awwwards-level craft: bold black (#000/#0a0a0a) and vivid yellow (#FFD400-ish) raffle aesthetic. Hybrid landing page and interactive web app. Kinetic hero, masked line-by-line reveal, numbered chapters, slow editorial marquee, spotlight product photography, framer-motion scroll reveals, lenis smooth scroll. High-contrast, premium, luxury tech feel.
theme_and_concept.audience: Brazilian users from Meta Ads. Mobile-first strategy.

headings.style: Expressive, tight letter-spacing (tracking-tight), radical weight contrast.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain texture overlay to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for floating headers/menus (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-black/60, border-white/10). No pure transparent backgrounds for overlays.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient yellow glow (drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,212,0,0.3)]) for selected elements/CTAs.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy. p-6, p-8, p-12. Deeply asymmetrical grids for marketing sections.
grids_and_layouts.raffle_grid: Dense grid for 500 numbers (grid-cols-5 to grid-cols-10 depending on breakpoint). Tight gap (gap-2), fully utilized pixels. Custom square aspect ratio.
grids_and_layouts.product_showcase: Bento grid or asymmetrical showcase with clipped frames and spotlight gradients on products.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Smooth scrolling mandatory using @studio-freight/lenis (or similar smooth scroll).
motion_and_interactions.hero: Kinetic text, masked line-by-line reveal using framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for trust signals or features (react-fast-marquee).
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Hover lifts (-translate-y-1), active states, focus rings. Staggered entrance animations for raffle numbers (batch rendering to maintain performance).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure yellow text/buttons have dark text inside them for APCA contrast compliance.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (ring-2 ring-accent ring-offset-2 ring-offset-background).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="buy-numbers-btn"`, `data-testid="number-selector-45"`).

media_and_images.image_treatment: Black background with yellow/gold shine. Spotlight effect.

components_and_features.hero: Contains 30-day countdown timer, kinetic title, primary CTA.
components_and_features.marquee: Endless running text 'COMPRA SEGURA • SORTEIO GARANTIDO • ENTREGA PARA TODO BRASIL'.
components_and_features.product_vitrine: Grid showcasing the 4 prizes with provided images.
components_and_features.raffle_selector: Interactive grid of 500 numbers. States: Free (dark grey), Selected (yellow), Reserved (red/dimmed). Multi-selection support.
components_and_features.checkout_bar: Sticky bottom bar appearing when numbers are selected, showing total R$ and 'Finalizar no WhatsApp' button.
components_and_features.number_lookup: Input field for phone number to check purchased numbers.
components_and_features.location: Section with Google Maps iframe for 'rua joão borges da matt q9 lt 14 MQ Assistencia'.
components_and_features.social_buttons: Fixed or prominently displayed WhatsApp and Instagram icons without raw text URLs.
components_and_features.progress_bar: Visual indicator of numbers sold vs total (500).

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-end, dark-mode, mobile-first web app with a Brazilian 'rifa' context.
Use framer-motion for animations: masked line reveals in the hero and scroll-triggered element fade-ins.
Install and use `react-fast-marquee` for the text marquee.
Implement smooth scrolling using `lenis` or apply smooth behavior globally.
Never apply `transition: all` globally. Apply specific transitions to interactive elements.
Ensure all components are strictly in standard React/Tailwind. Create components in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/` or use Shadcn if applicable.
Ensure standard testing attributes `data-testid` are on all buttons and interactive elements.
Avoid making generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical blocks for the marketing portions of the page.
Customize Shadcn components heavily to match the black/yellow premium theme. E.g. inputs should be dark with yellow focus rings.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
